name: Max von Fabeck
summary: German general given command, on 27 October 1914, of the force assembled between the Fourth and Sixth Armies for one more attempt on the Menin road - six divisions and the heaviest weight of artillery yet put behind an attack on that front. Its attack of 29-31 October broke the British line at Gheluvelt and could not get through the hole it made.

sources.note: the composition and the attack of Armeegruppe Fabeck, 29-31 October 1914
